answer: Make every agent pay its way in with a refundable stake locked in a shared vault: a new identity deposits coins it only recovers after a season of honest, peer-checked work. At its nadir, with no history and no stake, an identity may only do tiny sandboxed jobs inside a supervised haven where mistakes are cheap and every output is graded. Cloning a hundred identities then means funding a hundred stakes and staffing a hundred honest histories, while one caught duplicate forfeits its whole deposit and burns its record, so mass forgery costs more than it can ever earn.
